subject.title: feat: add controlled skills.sh metadata canary

question: Should ClawHub retain a permanent authenticated GitHub-backed Test canary that writes hidden catalog metadata, or should this remain a non-network fixture-only test path?
rationale: The choice creates an ongoing operator and credential boundary that source-level tests cannot settle: maintainers must decide whether live external verification is warranted for this permanent control-plane surface.

options.title: Approve the bounded live canary
options.body: Keep the authenticated one-row Test canary after rebasing and documenting the exact operator, deployment, and rollback boundary.

options.title: Use fixture-only verification
options.body: Remove the live GitHub verification dependency and retain deterministic fixture coverage if a permanent external credential path is not desired.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded live canary
recommendation.body: Keep the authenticated one-row Test canary after rebasing and documenting the exact operator, deployment, and rollback boundary.
